latin: Prima substantia prior est qualibet substantia habente habitudinem ad operationem transeuntem, quaecunque sit illa, alicuius causae siue formalis, siue materialis, siue efficientis, siue finalis.
translation: Whatever substance stands in relation to a transitive operation — be the cause involved formal, material, efficient, or final — is preceded by the first substance.
